description: Sri Lanka National Implementation Plan for the period 2026-2028 in accordance with the Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration is the first intergovernmentally negotiated United Nations instrument which covers all dimensions of international migration in a holistic manner. The said Compact was adopted by the Government of Sri Lanka at the United Nations General Assembly in December 2018.  In addition to providing overseas employment opportunities for Sri Lankan workers, the Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration provides necessary guidance to further enhance the positive outcomes of the migration process, such as contributing to the generation of remittances through the promotion of skills development.  It also supports countering malpractices in migration such as human trafficking and people smuggling. In order to implement the said Compact in Sri Lanka, an Implementation Committee was established in 2021 under the coconvening of the then Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the then Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment. The Committee had prepared Sri Lanka’s first National Implementation Plan in 2022.  However, due to the economic crisis prevailed in the country, the Plan could not be implemented, and the Committee was reconstituted in 2025. The said Committee, taking into account the views of all parties, prepared a National Implementation Plan for the Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration for the period 2026-2028. Accordingly, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism submitted the said Implementation Plan to the Cabinet, which granted its approval.
